scope: All unique fillName identities accepted by AllEquipment.findByName and therefore valid for the four original backpack save lists

authorities.iconSymbols: local-resources/regima/source/restored-swfs/ exact SymbolClass scan; EIcon1 preferred when duplicate names exist

fieldContract.fillName: stable original identity and modern registry key
fieldContract.inventoryCategory: equipment | items | fashion | skillBooks, mapped to zblist/djlist/szlist/jnslist
fieldContract.visibleCapacity: 125 entries per category (5 pages x 25); original code has no hard insertion limit
fieldContract.icon: stableKey, original requested symbol, resolved symbol, source package, character id and evidence
fieldContract.save: original field and MyEquipObj pipe-record encoding; modern V6 stores category/fillName/instance-or-stack identity/quantity
fieldContract.reachability: external-reference-observed | catalog-only-no-external-producer; the latter is not promoted to playable original content

knownOriginalDefects.conclusion: Three definitions share one fillName; reverse wpEquipment search makes wpEquip123 (3级昆仑玉, zbwp) authoritative. No external AS3 string producer and no exact restored SymbolClass exist.
The title bitmap exists, but ShowObj requests fmtstx without the role_title_ prefix and would fail exact lookup. No external AS3 string producer was found.
The fifth-level strengthening-stone bitmap exists without the sc prefix, but ShowObj requests scwpqhs5 and has no alias. No external AS3 string producer was found.
